items.caption: academie și membru postum
items.rationale: The posthumous qualifier is essential and immediately prevents the misleading idea of living Academy membership. The paired nouns remain true when either endpoint is current.

items.caption: academie și membru fondator
items.rationale: Founder is a specific institutional role, not a claim that Maiorescu founded every academy. Both endpoints identify the roles without a directional verb.

items.caption: revoluționar și ținut natal
items.rationale: The native-region phrase explains why a person connects to these mountains. It neither makes the mountains his creation nor restricts his activity to that location.

items.caption: oraș și regiune
items.rationale: The city/region distinction turns an opaque proper-name jump into a recognizable geographical hierarchy; reverse traversal preserves the same pair meaning.

items.caption: oraș și salină din apropiere
items.rationale: Nearby is a material qualifier: the player learns proximity without being told the salt mine is inside Cluj-Napoca. The phrase is clear within the 34-character limit.

items.caption: revistă și poet publicat
items.rationale: Published poet distinguishes literary contribution from employment, journal ownership or editorship. It reveals a useful association for the existing route without changing graph orientation.

items.caption: revistă și îndrumător literar
items.rationale: Literary guide is suitably precise for Maiorescu’s connection while avoiding a sole-editor title or an unsupported institutional office. It explains the cultural route to ordinary players.

items.caption: societate literară și poet
items.rationale: Naming the literary society and poet is considerably clearer than an abstract part/whole link. The roles are recognizable and do not imply ownership or co-founding.

items.caption: societate literară și mentor
items.rationale: Mentor distinguishes Maiorescu’s role from the neighboring poet/member role and gives players a specific reason for the connection in either direction.

items.caption: răscoală și ținutul ei
items.rationale: The revolt/territory phrase identifies a historical setting, not exclusive extent or ownership. It is a readable bridge between an event and its mountain region.

items.caption: chei și munții din care fac parte
items.rationale: This phrase makes geographical containment explicit. The grammar anchors the plural gorges to the mountain group, so reversing navigation cannot invert containment.

items.caption: răscoală și regiune
items.rationale: Event and region are immediately identifiable; the phrase explains location without reversing a past-tense verb or claiming that the entire region participated.

items.caption: obiective din zona Turda
items.rationale: The common Turda area supplies the otherwise invisible reason for pairing two tourist sites. It avoids claiming the gorge lies in the mine or both lie inside city limits.

checks.route_coverage: All 13 previously uncaptained edges across the six V93 shortest routes

limits: Bounded semantic and structural review. It does not establish enjoyment or physical-device readability.
